name: Smart Logistics Global Limited Ordinary Shares
summary: Smart Logistics Global Limited, operating alongside its various subsidiaries, delivers tailored business-to-business (B2B) logistics solutions across the People's Republic of China. Their core specialization involves the long-haul transportation of industrial raw materials. In addition to these services, the company also provides ground transportation, offers vehicle repair and maintenance, and sells essential automotive components like tires and spare parts. Its clientele spans a diverse range of sectors, including paper manufacturing, steel production, coal mining, and food processing, among others. Founded in 2017, the company maintains its headquarters in Pok Fu Lam, Hong Kong. Smart Logistics Global Limited functions as a subsidiary of ASL Ventures Limited.
